headline: 便當遭劫！公司冰箱爆國安危機
ticker: 午餐失蹤全辦震怒｜同事嘴角驚見飯粒｜冰箱主權誰來守護
anchor_script: 午休才剛開始！公司冰箱竟爆便當劫案！受害同仁開門一看，午餐原地蒸發！隔壁同事嘴角那顆飯粒，成為全案突破口！雞腿失守！滷蛋淪陷！主管緊急召開餐桌保衛會議，竟有人提議替花椰菜配置保全！現在全辦拿湯匙戒備，嫌疑人卻辯稱只是幫忙清冰箱！便當正義，難道只能靠微波爐加熱？

shots.scene_en: An office worker opens an unmarked refrigerator and recoils at an empty shelf in a plain office kitchenette, filmed from inside the refrigerator with no visible text, letters, or logos.
A sheepish coworker freezes with a rice grain on their lip and an open plain lunchbox in their lap at an office desk, captured in an extreme close-up with no visible text, letters, or logos.
The hungry worker drops to their knees and raises an empty lunchbox toward the ceiling in the kitchenette as coworkers gasp, filmed from a dramatic low angle with no visible text, letters, or logos.
A frantic manager convenes coworkers around a broccoli floret guarded by two tiny toy figures on a bare conference table, shown in an overhead shot with no visible text, letters, or logos.

Coworkers form a solemn spoon-wielding guard around the refrigerator while the guilty colleague sheepishly offers back a drumstick in the kitchenette, filmed in a wide frontal shot with no visible text, letters, or logos.
